newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Silja 1996 loss seen smaller.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Silja 1996 loss seen smaller.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 150 million markka median forecast full-year 1996 loss before extraordinary items and tax for Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy.
(Loss forecasts by 11 analysts, loss/shr by eight analysts).
Silja's results are due on February 12 in the morning. In 1995, Silja had a 389 million markka loss before extraordinary items and tax.

For the company's full-year 1997 earnings, six of the 11 analysts polled gave a median forecast of a 58 million markka profit (mean 56 million profit) ranging from a 72 million markka loss to a 153 million markka profit.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
